summary.key_theme: 受惠於 AI 驅動的電力需求成長與強勁的財報展望，加上與 California Resources Corporation 的策略合作，推動股價強勢反彈。

bullish.title: BE Stock Heads For Best Week In Over A Month: This Analyst Says Bloom’s Demand Trends Are Getting ‘Harder To Ignore’ — Barclays upgraded Bloom Energy stock to ‘Overweight’ from ‘Equal Weight’ with a price target of $289
bullish.reason: Barclays 將評級上調至「加碼」，並給出高目標價，顯示市場對其電力需求趨勢的認可度顯著提升。

bullish.title: BE Stock Rallies After-Hours On CRC Tie-Up Targeting 1GW Of Fuel-Cell Capacity
bullish.reason: 與 California Resources Corporation 簽署合作備忘錄，目標開發 1 GW 的燃料電池產能，為公司帶來長期的營收成長潛力。

bullish.title: Bloom Energy Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Guidance Hike & Capacity Plan
bullish.reason: 公司上調 2026 年財測，並積極擴張製造產能以應對 AI 數據中心帶來的強勁電力需求。

bullish.title: Bloom Energy: Ignore The Panic. Focus On The Explosive Growth Potential
bullish.reason: 強調公司基本面穩健，且由 AI 驅動的營收成長潛力足以抵銷市場短期恐慌。

bullish.title: S&P 500 Top Movers: Gainers and Losers on Nov. 3, 2026
bullish.reason: 反映股價在近期市場交易中表現強勢，位居標普 500 指數漲幅榜前列。

bearish.title: Watching Bloom Energy; Hunterbrook Media Issues Report Titled, “Bloom: Chinese Scandium Supply Route Restarts”; States Hunterbrook Capital Is Short $BE
bearish.reason: Hunterbrook Capital 發布放空報告，質疑其供應鏈（鈧元素）的穩定性，對公司營運透明度構成挑戰。

bearish.title: Bloom Energy Corporation (BE) Weighed on Clough Capital’s Portfolio in Q3 2026
bearish.reason: 機構投資人 Clough Capital 在第三季減持，顯示部分資本對其短期波動持謹慎態度。

neutral.title: Bloom Energy or Plug Power: Which Offers Better Long-Term Upside Now?
neutral.reason: 對比同業 Plug Power，指出 BE 在獲利能力上較佳，但同時提及估值溢價問題，觀點中立。

neutral.title: Is Bloom Energy (BE) Stock Cheap After AI Demand And Cash Flow Concerns?
neutral.reason: 探討 AI 需求與現金流疑慮之間的平衡，對股價是否被低估持保留態度。
